comment: NOT read by Bazel. Read by the publish-registry CI job, which fetches `archive` from the source repo and re-hosts the bytes into THIS registry's generic package at `package_path` so consumers read only infra/bazel-registry (one project, one auth scope) instead of every source repo. The job verifies the fetched archive's sha256 against the sibling source.json `integrity` before re-hosting.
